messages:
Lara: Quick check-in: who wants a bubble tea run? I can grab one on my way back. :boba: 
Ben: Me please. extra pearls, extra commitment. :heart_eyes:
Kai: I'll take one if it's taro. fun fact: taro is my spirit root.
Lara: noted. ETA 11:05. also tiny vote: if you could rename the kitchen, what would it be? drop one-word entries.
Ben: 'Snackatorium'
Kai: 'Caffeinearium'
Lara: 'Snackatorium' is winning already. :laughing:
fridge-bot: Reminder: labeled leftovers older than 7 days moved to compost bin at 5pm daily. :recycle: (automated)
Ben: tiny one-liner contest while we wait: best micro dad-joke wins the last cookie.
Kai: "Why did the spreadsheet go to therapy? too many unresolved cells."
Lara: "I put my headphones on to focus and they started a podcast about me."
Ben: "My to-do list and I had a falling-out; it keeps adding people."
Lara: votes: Kai's is crowned pun duke. :crown:
Kai: accepting my crown humbly. also shoutout to @Ben for fixing the plant light last week. it looks less dramatically droopy now. :seedling:
Ben: thanks! team effort. I'll bring an extra cookie for the gardener.
Lara: Bubble teas incoming. kitchen renamed 'Snackatorium' effective immediately. long live the Snackatorium. :tada:
metadata_note: Single Slack thread string with short watercooler banter, quick poll, a bot notice, one-liner contest, and a small kudos. No title field per agents.md rules.
